crossRefs.note: Then they secretly induced men to say, “We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses and God.”
crossRefs.keyword: An ungodly witness. Heb. a witness of Belial

crossRefs.note: His ways are prosperous at all times. He is arrogant, and your laws are far from his sight. As for all his adversaries…
He says in his heart, “God has forgotten. He hides his face. He will never see it.”
Therefore hear Yahweh’s word, you scoffers, that rule this people in Jerusalem:
saying, “There was a judge in a certain city who didn’t fear God, and didn’t respect man.
The heart of one who has understanding seeks knowledge, but the mouths of fools feed on folly.
how much less one who is abominable and corrupt, a man who drinks iniquity like water!
“Though wickedness is sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue,
though he spare it, and will not let it go, but keep it still within his mouth;
What man is like Job, who drinks scorn like water,
They feed on the sin of my people, and set their heart on their iniquity.

translations.web: A corrupt witness mocks justice, and the mouth of the wicked gulps down iniquity.
translations.bsb: A corrupt witness mocks justice, and a wicked mouth swallows iniquity.
translations.kjv: An ungodly witness scorneth judgment: and the mouth of the wicked devoureth iniquity.
translations.asv: A worthless witness mocketh at justice; And the mouth of the wicked swalloweth iniquity.
